notes: Eligibility is a judgement call but defensible: robot_state_publisher (consumer) reads the robot_description parameter; kobuki.urdf.xacro is a macro library that, expanded standalone, yields no <link> elements, so the value crossing the boundary is structurally empty. I disagree with the class field: the spec's own notes say 'Classification other is used', yet the failed_conditions JSON carries 'representation_convention', which the S1 taxonomy reserves for component/byte order, handedness, or encoding. An empty provider value is neither of these; 'other' is correct and matches the spec's own notes. The spec thus contradicts itself. Loudness (loud_documented, activate) and resolution (recommended, fix adds a new standalone xacro + launcher without a shown working composition) are consistent with the sources I read.
